description:
Rei (Tentative Name) pilots Evangelion Mark.09.
Follows orders without question, and often acts and speaks in a way that suggests a complete lack of personal identity.
Asuka often refers to her as being from an early lot of the Ayanami series.

lines.text: How do I get to the library?
The happiness of not having to board an Eva...
I'm happy to be with everyone.
It's nice not having to ride in the Eva.
Is there anything I can do?
So this is the village where you and the Nikkes reside...
Is there work to do here as well?
Did the Raptures break this too?
My name? I have no idea.
Thank you. Is that the right way to say it?
I want everyone to have a good time together.
A handshake is a spell intended to get closer to someone.
Here too... is a place I will protect.
What would the original Rei Ayanami do in a situation like this?
I've learned how to play an instrument to a degree.
You look happy. What's going on?
The Nikkes have told me that peace means we can throw a party anytime.
Would you like to hear me play?
Once we've gotten rid of the Raptures, I'll return and continue practicing.
Will there be another concert next time...?
Are there any children in this place?
Is it my job to protect this place?
It's the same as training, just with a different outfit.
A performance, in return for the gift.
Everyone, play some sounds... I mean, music.
I can't hear their laughter, nor the music...
I wanted to be with everyone...
We won, so shouldn't we be celebrating?
